knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Opening stock only at refill keeps it clean and stops it from being left on a shelf or the floor.
An overfilled dispenser can fail to dispense, which wastes stock and causes faults.
The SA standard says topping up is not acceptable and that liquid soap and cleaner containers should be disposable.

practicalCriteria: Learner replenishes a sample dispenser in the right sequence, with the assessor marking each step; pass when all seven steps are in order
Learner identifies one jammed sample dispenser and states the correct action without forcing the mechanism, with the action correct
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor sign-off of the practical replenishment
stopWorkCriteria: A dispenser is faulty or jammed in a way that risks injury
Stock is found on the ground or contaminated and cannot be replaced
